The Chinese characters for Julian

As a transliteration, Julian is usually written 朱利安 (Zhū lì ān). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Zhū

利
lì

安
ān

Origin and meaning

Julian is a Latin name meaning “youthful (from Julius)”.

About the name Julian

From the Roman name Julius, shared by the emperor Julian.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Julian carries the meaning “youthful (from Julius)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
